notablePrerequisites: You control at least two modified creatures.
easyPrerequisites:
Biorganic Carapace is attached to an artifact creature you control that does not have summoning sickness and that cannot be blocked by an opponent.
You control a permanent that can tap to produce {U} and a permanent that can tap to produce {R}.
description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using the creature that has Biorganic Carapace attached, triggering it.
Holding priority, activate Tawnos by paying {U}{R} and tapping it, copying the creature's trigger.
Resolve the copy of the creature's ability, drawing a card for each modified creature you control.
Holding priority, activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Tawnos.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping a mana-producing permanent.
Activate the mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding {U/R}.
Repeat from step 5 one additional time.
Repeat from step 2.
